jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Senior Commodity Manager to support strategic procurement and commodity management within the gas turbine business.
The organisation is experiencing significant growth and needs to strengthen its supplier base to secure sufficient delivery capacity for medium-sized gas turbines.
You will support different material categories depending on business requirements, working closely with the Commodity Management team. Relevant categories include forgings, castings and machining.
What You Will Work On
Support different commodity and material categories.
Analyse procurement data and prepare reports and information summaries.
Identify, evaluate and introduce new suppliers.
Source and procure components from suppliers.
Drive corrective action programmes to address major supply chain deviations.
Support and coach stakeholders in various commodity management areas.
Collaborate with Commodity Managers and procurement leadership.

What You Bring
Several years of experience in Commodity Management.
Experience working in an industrial manufacturing environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.
Degree in Engineering (MSc) or Business/Economics (MSc).
Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Experience with gas turbines or heavy industrial equipment.
Knowledge of forgings, castings and machining.
Experience in supplier development and supply chain improvement.
Experience managing supplier capacity and delivery challenges.

jobs.occupation: Intensive Care Nurses Wanted for Mora Hospital, Region Dalarna, Sweden
jobs.description:
Region Dalarna is looking for experienced Intensive Care Nurses to join the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) at Mora Hospital.

As an ICU nurse, you will care for critically ill patients requiring advanced monitoring and treatment. You will work closely with anaesthesiologists, physicians and other healthcare professionals to provide specialised care in a technologically advanced environment.

The ICU at Mora Hospital combines high-quality critical care with the advantages of a smaller hospital setting, offering close collaboration, strong team spirit and excellent opportunities for professional growth.

What We Offer
.A challenging and rewarding role in critical care
.Access to modern medical technology and equipment
.Supportive multidisciplinary teams
.Continuing education and professional development opportunities
.A 22-week intensive Swedish language programme, starting in either February or August each year. Participants receive an educational salary while studying Swedish towards C1 level, a requirement for obtaining Swedish nursing licensure. More information about our language course can be found here: 
https://youtu.be/O6JM1271MbE?si=IB1r4QSNn9ooWR-l
.A modern working environment with state-of-the-art clinical equipment
.Opportunities for continuing education and shadowing
.A minimum of 25 days of paid vacation per year
.A permanent contract, conditioned with at least 2 years of service in Region Dalarna
.Assistance for partners/spouses in finding job opportunities in Dalarna

Candidate Profile
We are looking for nurses who:
.Hold an Intensive Care Nursing qualification within the EU/EEA
.Are EU/EEA citizens
.Have at least 3 years of ICU experience
.Possess English language skills at CEFR B2 level or higher
.Demonstrate strong clinical skills and sound judgement
.Work well under pressure and in team-based environments
.Are committed to providing safe and compassionate care

EURES mobility supports may be available if you apply to this vacancy. Please check 
https://arbetsformedlingen.se/other-languages/english-engelska/eures-targeted-mobility-scheme-tms-sweden/for-jobseekers

About Us
We are a Swedish IT and software development company expanding into taxi and delivery services.
Our vision is to combine technology with transportation by developing AI-powered solutions for scheduling, route planning, operational monitoring, and business administration.
We aim to create efficient, reliable, and customer-focused transport services while gradually introducing intelligent automation into our daily operations.
Job Description
We are looking for responsible and service-oriented Taxi Drivers to join our growing transport business in Stockholm.

Provide safe, reliable, and professional passenger transportation.
Accept and complete bookings through digital taxi platforms and dispatch systems.
Ensure excellent customer service and passenger satisfaction.
Maintain vehicle cleanliness, safety, and general condition.

Valid Swedish taxi-driver licence (Taxiförarlegitimation).
Valid driving licence suitable for taxi operations.
Responsible driving attitude and good customer service skills.

Interest in technology and AI-supported transportation systems.

Salary and employment conditions in accordance with applicable Swedish taxi industry collective agreement standards.

Salary: According to qualifications, applicable collective agreement standards, and agreed employment terms.
Start Date: As agreed.

As a UX Artist at Embark, your job is to enable amazing user experiences for our gamers, experiences that they will remember and talk about for decades. If you like to spend time thinking about how players explore and experience games, and perhaps you also imagine a future where players can be part of creating their own unique experiences, then Embark might be your future home. 
Example of responsibilities 

Collaborate with a wide range of talents at Embark to deliver a great user experience

Evaluating different software, techniques, engines and pipelines and help us get better and change how we work in the future

A creative and curious mind

Minimum 3 years of relevant professional art experience

Experience working with game engines and implementation, usability, and visual fidelity

A strong passion for art, design and games

Excellent visual skillset and deep artistic understanding and knowledge

Experience of following directions and deliver to quality from a visual, game play and technical perspective

Professional English communication skills

Job Scope 
High level purpose of function. 
The Senior Engineer will lead key aspects of electrode process development from lab-scale to mass production. This includes optimizing slurry formulations and coating parameters, resolving manufacturing issues, and collaborating across departments and with vendors to ensure product quality and stability. 
Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Develop and optimize electrode slurry formulation, coating, and calendaring processes. 
Design experiments (DOE) and analyse test results to identify root causes and implement improvements. 
Provide technical support for pilot line and mass production scale-up. 
Coordinate with material vendors and equipment suppliers for process troubleshooting. 
Mentor junior engineers and review technical documentation. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Bachelor’s degree with at least 5 years of experience or Master’s degree with at least 3 years in electrode process development or related field. 
Hands-on experience in LIB manufacturing, R&D, or process engineering is essential. 
In-depth knowledge of electrode processes such as slurry mixing, coating, drying, and calendaring. 
Experience with DOE (Design of Experiments) and statistical analysis tools. 
Practical experience in mass production application or process troubleshooting. 
Prior experience in working with equipment vendors or material suppliers. 

Specific skills 
Familiarity with statistical tools (e.g., Minitab) for process optimization. 
Understanding of equipment structure and process flow in electrode production. 
Root cause analysis skills (e.g., FMEA, 5 Whys) and strong technical reporting. 
Proficiency in English technical communication and documentation. 

Personal success factors 
Proactive approach in identifying and solving technical issues. 
Strong cross-functional communication and coordination skills. 
Willingness to mentor and guide junior team members. 
Customer- and quality-focused mindset.

As a Reliability Engineer, you'll help take the plant from construction to stable operations. You'll oversee the installation and commissioning of cranes, conductor systems, monorails and other lifting equipment, ensuring safe, high-quality delivery. Once the plant is running, you'll improve the reliability and performance of our lifting equipment by developing maintenance strategies, solving technical challenges and driving continuous improvements.
Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.
Oversee the installation and commissioning of EOT cranes, conductor systems, monorails and other lifting equipment.
Work with contractors, OEMs and internal teams to deliver safe, high-quality installations.
Prepare maintenance plans, spare parts strategies and documentation to support a smooth handover to operations.
Investigate equipment failures, identify root causes and implement long-term improvements.
Develop preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to increase equipment reliability and reduce downtime.
Use maintenance and performance data to improve the reliability, availability and lifetime of cranes and lifting equipment.

What you’ll bring
Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:
Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
Hands-on experience installing, commissioning, maintaining or improving the reliability of cranes or industrial lifting equipment.
Experience from heavy industry, manufacturing or industrial maintenance.
Good understanding of crane systems, electrical and mechanical equipment, and relevant industry standards.
Experience with reliability methods such as RCA, FMEA and preventive or predictive maintenance, as well as CMMS/EAM systems (e.g. SAP PM, Hexagon or Maximo).
Good English communication skills. Swedish is an advantage.

Experience with Git and CI/CD.
Strong English communication skills.

Meritorious
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science or a related field.
Databricks or AWS certifications.
Experience with Terraform.
Experience building shared platforms used by multiple teams.
Knowledge of data quality, metadata, data lineage and data discoverability.
Experience with cloud cost monitoring and optimisation.
Experience handling large volumes of vehicle or sensor data.

jobs.occupation: Reliability Engineer / Asset Management Engineer, Addilon Professionals AB
jobs.description:
Drive Strategic Maintenance Excellence in Gothenburg
Join a large-scale industrial project as a Senior Reliability Engineer, where you will take both strategic and operational responsibility for asset structures and maintenance tactics. This hybrid contract role offers the opportunity to influence long-term reliability for critical infrastructure while collaborating with a global engineering team.
The Role and Your Impact
Reporting to the Asset Management Project Manager, you will act as the technical linchpin between our global project resources and the local Gothenburg site. Your focus will be on building a robust foundation for asset performance through structured data and proactive strategies.
Key Responsibilities
Establish and optimize technical asset hierarchies and Bill of Materials (BOM).
Define maintenance tactics utilizing RCM, FMEA, or PMO methodologies.
Ensure all maintenance strategies comply with ISO 55000 standards and local regulations.
Manage technical interfaces and present deliverables to diverse stakeholder groups.
Verify the accuracy of technical data within CMMS/EAM environments.

Professional Requirements
We are looking for a senior specialist with a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical or Maintenance Engineering. You must have at least 5 years of experience in Reliability Engineering within large-scale industrial environments. Proficiency in English is mandatory for managing international stakeholders, alongside advanced skills in systems like SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or IFS. Deep knowledge of ISO 55000 is a prerequisite for success in this role.
Preferred Qualifications
Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) status.
Experience working with remote international teams.
Knowledge of Spare Parts Optimization and Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analysis.

What We Offer
Senior contract position in a high-profile industrial project.
Hybrid work arrangement based in Gothenburg.
Collaboration with an international team of 5 dedicated engineers.

Ready to optimize? Apply now to become our next Asset Management expert.
